ratings_why.fun: Three axes that tangle (Eggs, sleepers, the clock) and a real slot bet every turn, held back from 8 by a weak early game and a heavy rules load.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because no tribe feeds on the enemy's own size or acts mid-fight on a shared clock; empty slots as nest boxes is new.

verdict_why: The engine is right; a couple of timing rules (Ottilie with hide and sleep effects, when innate sleepers fall asleep) need writing down.

points.text: Ottilie's 'happen twice' is unreadable on Little Gernegroß (hide twice?) and Curfew Warden (sleep at the Hour, then wake at the next one?). Say what doubling does to one-off effects.

Asleep says it wakes at the next Hour after it fell asleep, but Jar Dormouse never says when it fell asleep; with Wind 4 does it wake before the first attack? State that innate sleepers fall asleep at Start of Combat.
Key-Turner against your own sleepers is a lovely tension: Wind makes Eggs safe but wakes the jar early. Keep it, and maybe give one Dormouse a payoff for a late Hour so the tension cuts both ways.
Nest-Box Dormouse plus deliberate empty slots plus Mother Rohrsang is the best combo here; a second card that cares where a Chick lands would deepen it.
Frau Wechselbalg's Discover from the host's tribe is a great off-label pivot tool; say what happens when the host is neutral or a Clockworks Chick.

standouts.why: Eats your own temporary Chicks for permanent stats, so where you leave holes becomes a combo choice.
Doubles any tribe's Start of Combat cards, a bridge into whatever the lobby offers.
Puts another tribe's carry to sleep, protecting and buffing it: a use well outside the tribe's own theme.

weakest.why: Flat gold for the first Hour; with Wind it always pays and there is no decision.
A plain End of Turn Brood ticker with nothing to play around.
Same Brood job as Egg-Painter one tier up, with little new interaction.

flags.note: Doubles every other tribe's Start of Combat card, triples when golden.
Golden Tower (Hour every attack) with Door Cuckoo spams Eggs and maxes Old Unruh fast.
Under Ottilie, does he hide twice, and on which host?
Golden Rohrsang with Little Gernegroß takes twice the host's whole stats.
When an innate sleeper fell asleep isn't stated, so its wake Hour is ambiguous with Wind.
